Sam, Priya, Kimberly —

Quick notes from finance/ops on billing flow options:
Option A — Provider-billed (recommended for AWS):
- Private offer created in AWS Marketplace; AWS issues invoices to LuminaCore and handles tax/charges.
- Pros: single-source billing for your team; quicker approval in orgs that prefer provider invoices.
- Cons: requires your AWS Marketplace account linkage and PO reference in the private offer metadata.

Option B — Redwood-invoiced (fallback for GCP):
- Redwood activates private SKU in GCP and invoices LuminaCore monthly. We pass through cloud usage but Redwood handles invoicing and collects payment.
- Pros: simpler for clouds where private-offer billing is inconsistent.
- Cons: longer finance onboarding (vendor setup) and requires payment terms to be agreed upfront.

Action items we need from LuminaCore to lock this down:
- Confirm which cloud will be Option A vs Option B per your internal finance preference.
- Confirm expected 12-month ARR so we can set private-offer discounts and quota sizing.
- If Option A for AWS — share AWS Marketplace account ID and PO routing email.

I’ll also upload a short billing runbook to the Drive link Kimberly shared.

—Jordan Blake
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
